note: This data is expressed in [international-$](#dod:int_dollar_abbreviation) at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, [per capita](#dod:per-capita).
title: Mean income or consumption per month within the richest decile
subtitle: The mean income or consumption per month within the richest decile (tenth of the population). This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
